findings.method: CSV vs markdown inventory; git show origin/main
findings.observation: REQ-DASH-004 / DASH-DENSITY-002 is defined in DASHBOARD_REQUIREMENTS.md. origin/main CSV already has the row (172 data rows) but REQUIREMENTS.md still claimed 171 active / 150 MUST and crosswalk.md listed DASH-001..003 only. CSV executable_surface pointed at test_dashboard_presentation_requirements.py instead of the scalar-density tests.
findings.expected: REQUIREMENTS.md counts and crosswalk snapshot equal CSV rows; executable_surface names the scalar-density tests.
findings.impact: Operators cannot treat the catalog index as SSOT for dashboard scalar density.
findings.root_cause: DASH-004 was added to CSV without updating REQUIREMENTS.md / crosswalk.md counts.
findings.remediation: Bump catalog to v1.12.6 / 172 / 151 MUST; point CSV at scalar-density tests.

findings.method: Regex REQ-[A-Z]+(?:-[A-Z]+)*-\d{3} in tests/ vs CSV catalog
findings.observation: tests/ cited IDs absent from the CSV: REQ-ARCH-008+, REQ-CONF-*, REQ-PERF-*, REQ-DOC-010, REQ-DETERM-001, REQ-DQ-010/020/030, REQ-OBS-CONTRACT-001.
findings.expected: Every REQ-*-NNN in tests/ is a catalog ID.
findings.actual: Invented aliases in architecture, performance, config, and DQ tests.
findings.impact: Traceability searches and coverage claims bind to IDs that do not exist.
findings.root_cause: Tests used local numbering instead of the crosswalk catalog.
findings.remediation: Map to REQ-ARCH-001, REQ-DOC-001, REQ-DQ-001, REQ-RETRY-002, REQ-OBS-001; drop REQ-CONF-* / REQ-PERF-*.
